packageRules.description: Every update, major ones included, in one weekly PR. Lock file maintenance is off because Renovate can't group it; the grouped PR refreshes the lock files of what it bumps.
The SGLang base image is a 16 GB pull and changes every backend image tag: its own PR, checked with the GPU lifecycle example before merging.

CI runs the versions the project supports at the bottom of its range: Python 3.12 (the private Aider engine), Node.js 20 (the stated minimum), and Ubuntu 22.04 for the .deb and AppImage builds (older glibc). Don't move them.
TypeScript 7 (the native port) has no JavaScript API, which scripts/check_regexes.py uses to find patterns, and svelte-check 4 accepts only TypeScript 5 or 6. Held so the grouped PR stays green.

Breaking Rust releases that need code changes (reqwest 0.13 renamed the rustls-tls feature and switched the default crypto provider; rand 0.10 and sha2 0.11 changed their traits). Held until migrated by hand, so the grouped PR stays green.
